s2s/audio_server.py.source: Repository adaptation: retain native batch aggregate results; add metadata-only first-four-second PCM16 fingerprints for decoded/resampled/submitted audio, dropped-input count, and cumulative/raw-to-final ASR hashes. Uses existing diagnostic flag; this file does not alter RNNT, prompt, audio or inference parameters.

s2s/prompt_template.jinja.source: User-supplied deployed voicechat-prompt-template.jinja; strict session policy and single-call examples updated in this repository; search_knowledge_base(query) example covers consumer and business product facts and forbids lack-of-access responses when a registered tool covers the request

opt/tritonserver/backends/nemotron-voice.source: User-supplied load_utils.py uploaded 2026-10-19, preserved byte-for-byte with LF newlines. Converting only LF to CRLF reproduces the supplied deployed checksum; no code changes.

s2s/tests/test_response_lifecycle.py.source: Repository CPU regression: real decode/resample/submission fingerprints, unmodified samples, ASR parts and IDs, diagnostics disabled, and no transcript content in logs; retain batch aggregate result tests.

opt/tritonserver/backends/nemotron-voice.source: Repository RNNT display-only fix: initialize predictor with y=None, add_sos=False (one zero step) to match NeMo GreedyRNNTInfer; preserve EOU/BOU, encoder frames, thresholds, weights and tool/PAD behavior. The upstream VoiceChat wrapper also has the former double-zero pattern; CPU recurrence/counterexample tests do not establish the deployed speech root cause or accuracy. Repository completion follow-up: after the existing PAD-tail forced EOS, suppress unsolicited text/function tokens before TTS, parsing and subsequent model history until new RNNT speech or a result for an outstanding native call. Preserve the display predictor fix, listening, original thresholds, ACK and full-duplex context; no weight or engine speed changes.

s2s/tests/test_rnnt_transcript.py.source: Repository CPU regression executing the archived display method with a real LSTM and controlled joint: canonical greedy recurrence, blank lead-in state, two fixed token sequences, and a legacy double-zero prefix counterexample. No pretrained weights, speech/GPU accuracy or turn-taking claims.

s2s/tests/requirements.txt.source: Pinned independent CPU test environment; add CPU PyTorch and its dependencies for RNNT predictor tests. Do not install into API or GPU inference environments.

opt/tritonserver/backends/nemotron-voice.source: Repository sequence-local awaiting_new_input field for the existing PAD completion fallback; reset on new speech or a valid outstanding tool result. Full source mounted with model.py.
